倒霉少女魂璃璃（倒霉少女魂璃璃（第22页）魂璃璃捂住变得有些许红润之色的嘴唇，干呕了一下，蹙眉道。而她身上的气息，却不再是斗之气三段，而是，斗王三星。“什么意思？”魂璃璃脸色难看地望着魂天帝。她发现，她的神品血脉，连着掉了两个等阶！现在只能勉强维持在八品了。“有舍就有得，虽然血脉品阶掉了，但十五岁的斗王，在族内已经是遥遥领先同龄人了，况且，你的血脉本就源自于我，我需要用，便拿来用，反正只要你还是处子之身，迟早都能养回来。”魂天帝淡然说道。你是真下头啊，生物爹！真得给你挂小红书！魂璃璃差点就忍不住开口骂出声。但眼前这人她惹不起。魂天帝，斗气大陆第一疯子，献祭全族血脉，只为一人成帝。她穿越来的时候，就直接被吓晕过去了。为什么别人穿越就是药族圣女，或者是纳兰嫣然，小医仙什么的，她穿越却有个把她当血奴的畜牲爹？自打六岁觉醒九品以后，她就没见过生母了。八岁那年，她血脉达到了神品。她那时觉得自己好歹也是神品血脉，总该有点话语权，于是问了魂天帝母亲的去向。魂天帝说，作为魂族的大小姐，神品血脉，不需要太多的亲情羁绊，也不用想着去找，和那些给她测验血脉的魂使一样，死人才能保守秘密。也是在那年，年幼的她被活生生剥离了一身神品血脉，修炼了整整七年，斗之气在三段止步不前，好在灵魂力量倒是有些增长，有了一些自保的能力。八岁之前，是魂殿替她解决魂使的问题。八岁之后，是她自己解决魂使的问题。压下心中的浓郁杀意，魂璃璃冷漠地望着魂天帝，道：“养好了再被你抽走吗？”魂天帝还真的认真思考了一番，才说道：“等你养好，至少也要十年的时间，十年后，我已经不需要你的血脉了，不过…这种事情，其实也说不定。”“我真是谢谢您哈！”魂璃璃满脸假笑，咬牙切齿地说道。“嗯，不用客气。”魂天帝点点头，似乎完全没有听出少女语气中的恨意。“我要出魂界。”魂璃璃深吸一口气，说道。“理由。”魂天帝道。“这里人太恶心，灵魂污浊，让人难以下咽，我要去外面吃新鲜的！”魂璃璃气愤地像是被饿了七天的孩子。“我让魂灭生亲自去抓最新鲜的灵魂给你。”魂天帝这会儿倒是想起来眼前的女儿是亲生的了，一句话就要让五星斗圣去跑腿。“你让垃圾大王亲手给我送吃的？你到底是不是我亲爹？”魂璃璃咬牙切齿，握紧拳头，脊背微微弓起。“罢了，这是族内的令牌，见此令牌，等同见到魂灭生，你带着它，不管需要什么，都可以跟着令牌的感应，直接去魂殿调集，若是遇到危险，就将其捏碎，魂灭生会亲自过去。”魂天帝将一块令牌递给了魂璃璃。“不是你来？”魂璃璃蹙眉。“我走不开。”魂天帝摇头。“那太好了！”魂璃璃松了一口气，扭头就斗气化翼，向着魂界之外飞去。

Unlucky girl Hun Lili (Unlucky girl Hun Lili (page 22) Hun Lili covered her lips that turned slightly red, retched, and frowned. But the aura on her body was no longer the third stage of fighting spirit. Instead, Dou Wang Sanxing. "What do you mean?" Hun Lili looked at Hun Tiandi with an ugly expression. She found that her divine bloodline had dropped two levels in a row! "If you give it up, you will get it." , although the bloodline level has been lost, the fifteen-year-old Dou Wang is already far ahead of his peers in the clan. Besides, your bloodline comes from me. If I need to use it, I will use it. Anyway, as long as you are still a virgin. , sooner or later he can be raised back." Emperor Hun Tian said calmly. You are so humble, biological father! I really need to put a little red book on you! Hun Lili almost couldn't help but curse. But she can't afford to offend this person in front of her. Emperor Hun Tian, Dou The number one lunatic in the Qi Continent, who sacrificed his whole family's bloodline to become the emperor. When she came through time, she was frightened and fainted. Why did she have a beast father who treated her as a blood slave when she came across time? When she was eight years old, her bloodline reached the divine level. She should have some say, so she asked the Soul Heaven Emperor about her mother's whereabouts. The Soul Heaven Emperor said that as the eldest daughter of the Soul Clan, she didn't need too much family ties, and she didn't need to think about finding it. Just like those soul envoys who tested her bloodline, only the dead could keep the secret. It was also that year when she was stripped alive of her divine bloodline. She had been practicing for seven years, but her fighting spirit had stopped at the third level. Fortunately, her soul power was somewhat Before she was eight years old, it was the Soul Palace that solved the problem of the Soul Envoy. After she was eight years old, it was she who solved the problem of the Soul Envoy. Suppressing the strong murderous intention in her heart, Hun Lili looked at the Soul Emperor indifferently and said, "Will I be taken away by you after I am raised?" The Emperor of the Soul thought about it seriously before saying, "It will take at least ten years for you to be raised well. After ten years, I will no longer need your blood, no. "I'm really thankful for you!" Hun Lili said through gritted teeth. "Well, you're welcome." Hun Tiandi nodded, seemingly not hearing the hatred in the girl's voice. "I want to leave the soul world." Hun Lili took a deep breath and said. "The people here are too disgusting, and the souls are so filthy that it's hard to eat." Lili looked angrily like a child who had been starved for seven days. "I asked Hun Mie Sheng to personally catch the freshest soul for you." At this moment, Emperor Hun Tian remembered that the daughter in front of him was his biological child, and he would make Five Stars fight with one word. Sheng went to run errands. "You asked the Garbage King to personally deliver food to me? Are you my biological father?" Hun Lili gritted her teeth, clenched her fists, and arched her back slightly, "That's all, this is the token of the clan. Seeing this token, When you see Hun Mie Sheng, you can take it with you and follow the induction of the token to gather it directly in the Soul Palace. If you encounter danger, crush it and Hun Mie Sheng will go there in person." The token was handed to Hun Lili. "Aren't you here?" Hun Lili frowned. "I can't leave." Hun Lili shook his head. "That's great!" Hun Lili breathed a sigh of relief, turned around and flew out of the soul world.
